# Pinterest Ads

Pinterest Ads API for managing advertising accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, targeting, and reporting.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/pinterest-ads/.

## Actions

- **Get Ads Analytics** (read-only): Get synchronous Pinterest Ads performance metrics for an advertiser or selected campaigns, ad groups, or ads over a date range.
- **Get Metrics Ready State** (read-only): Check whether Pinterest conversion and non-conversion metrics are finalized for a UTC report date before relying on analytics results.
- **Get Targeting Options** (read-only): Get Pinterest's valid targeting values for a targeting type, such as age buckets, gender, locale, location, interests, or keywords.
- **List Ad Accounts** (read-only): List advertiser accounts the connected Pinterest user owns or can access, including the IDs needed by all other Ads tools.
- **List Ad Groups** (read-only): List ad groups for an advertiser, filter by parent campaigns, or look up specific ad groups by ID.
- **List Ads** (read-only): List ads for an advertiser, filter by one hierarchy level, or look up specific ads by ID.
- **List Campaigns** (read-only): List campaigns for an advertiser, or look up specific campaigns by ID using campaign_ids.
- **Update Ad Groups**: Rename, pause, or resume up to 30 existing ad groups.
- **Update Ads**: Rename, pause, or resume up to 30 existing Pinterest ads.
- **Update Campaigns**: Rename, pause, or resume up to 30 existing campaigns.
